title: Double Honey Haloumi & Veggie Couscous
subtitle: with Garlic Yoghurt
description: Sweet and salty is a match made in heaven... and on your plate! This meal brings together honey and haloumi for a veggie feast you won't be able to forget.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced.
• Cut carrot and zucchini into thick half-moons. Cut tomato into wedges. Slice lemon into wedges.
• Place carrot, zucchini, tomato, garlic & herb spice blend, a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper on the lined oven tray. Toss to coat, spread out evenly and roast until tender, 20-25 mins.
• Cut haloumi into 1cm slices (you should get 3 pieces per person).

• Meanwhile, finely chop or crush garlic. In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium-high heat.
• Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 min. Add the water and salt and bring to the boil.
• Add couscous and stir to combine. Cover with a lid and remove from heat.
• Set aside until water is absorbed, 5 mins. Fluff up with a fork.

• While couscous is cooking, in a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook haloumi until golden brown, 2 mins each side (Cook in batches if your pan is getting crowded). Remove from heat, add honey and a splash of water and turn to coat.

• Add roast veggies and a squeeze of lemon juice to couscous. Toss to combine and season to taste.
• Divide couscous between plates. Top with haloumi and garlic aioli. Serve with remaining lemon wedges.
